items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I think it was Billy and Jimmy.

ctx.x: Was he playing by himself with the band or was Billy Taylor playing the bass too? When he first came in the band they had two bass players. I think it was Billy Taylor --
Yeah, I think it was Billy and Jimmy.
Were they both together when you heard the band or was --
